author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: PDF-only: Custom System Options and Customization sections are now skipped entirely (no header, no '—' placeholder, no subtotal row) when nothing was selected/written for them — was just blank space on the printed quote. ISO Certification still always shows its explicit 'Not included' line, and Base Product/Standard Options are unaffected (never empty on a real quote). On-screen in the Quote tab, nothing changed — this only trims the downloaded PDF. Totals/math are unaffected either way.
